resources.string: One tap to play your chosen audiobook, podcast, album, playlist, artist or song in Spotify
Tap to choose what to play
In Spotify, open an audiobook, podcast, album, playlist, artist or song, tap Share → One-Tap Play. Or paste a link here.
Not a recognized Spotify link (expected open.spotify.com/…/…)
Then long-press your home screen → Widgets → One-Tap Play.
Spotify didn\'t respond; opening it in Spotify instead
Log in to the Spotify app first
%1$s is playing on %2$s. Play %3$s on this phone instead? That will stop it there.
On: the widget\'s button becomes Stop while Spotify is playing on this phone.
To turn the widget\'s Play button into Stop while Spotify plays on this phone, allow notification access. The app only watches Spotify\'s playback state.
If the switch is greyed out (\"Restricted setting\"): open App info for One-Tap Play → ⋮ menu → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
